events.verdict: Post (GSW) firms up over his left leg in Maxey's (PHI) path prior to contact.
Barlow (PHI) legally contests Santos' (GSW) shot attempt.
Maxey (PHI) moves alongside Spencer's (GSW) path as they come together on the perimeter.
Edgecombe (PHI) inbounds the ball within five seconds.
Spencer (GSW) swipes his hand down and initiates contact with Grimes' (PHI) arm as he defends the shot.  The foul is called on Spencer although it was attributed to Santos (GSW).
Melton (GSW) establishes his left foot as his pivot foot, and he maintains his pivot foot after his gather.
Melton (GSW) legally contests Maxey's (PHI) shot attempt.
Spencer (GSW) moves into Bona's (PHI) lower body and dislodges him from his rebounding position.
Melton (GSW) cleanly ties up Edgecombe (PHI) and a jump ball is correctly called.
Melton (GSW) and Edgecombe's (PHI) pursue the jump ball and the contact is marginal.
Bona (PHI) legally contests Melton's (GSW) shot attempt.
Maxey (PHI) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on Santos (GSW) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Edgecombe (PHI) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds and possession is awarded to the Warriors.
Grimes (PHI) brings his left hand to the ball in an attempt to tie it up Hield (GSW) and his hand maintains contact with the ball.

Replay review of the foul called on Edgecombe (PHI) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Edgecombe dislodges the ball from Post (GSW) and the ensuing contact with Post's arm is incidental. At the time of the whistle, the Warriors had imminent possession and play resumes with Golden State ball.

After deflecting the ball away from Hield (GSW), Edgecombe (PHI) runs into Barlow (PHI) and loses his balance as a result of the contact from his teammate.  Edgecombe then secures the loose ball and Philadelphia signals for, and is granted, a timeout.
Edgecombe (PHI) inbounds the ball within five seconds.  Before the ball is inbounded, the game clock erroneously runs from 08.2 seconds remaining to 07.8 seconds remaining.
Melton (GSW) legally contests Maxey's (PHI) jump shot attempt.
Spencer (GSW) contests Edgecombe's (PHI) shot at the basket, and the contact after the release is marginal.
Maxey (PHI) cleanly blocks Melton's (GSW) shot attempt.
